title: Home
physical_identity: A small unremarkable town of about 4,000 residents with a breakfast place, a school and a decaying house, narrated by the town itself.
scale_topology: Finite outdoor/indoor small town; school basement mentioned; size not given.
anomalies: town adapts to the visitor's memories
rot that grows when noticed or when absent
lighting_sound: Sound of skin breaking from the sky; smell of burning rust; no lighting stated (bleak blue sky and cold air in a memory).
